title: Cal Kestis
description: Cal Kestis was a Jedi Knight who escaped Order 66 and crafted a new life on Bracca. One day, Jedi-hunting Inquisitors arrived. Kestis found a way to escape, and a new home, with the crew of the Stinger Mantis. Together, they tracked down a fabled Jedi Holocron. Kestis decided it was best to destroy the artifact so it couldn't be used for evil.
